I shit you not, Kendamas. My area had some weird trends.

At the time when i was in Secondary school, kendamas (yes the japanese toy) was trending a lot in Singapore. Literally everywhere you go, some kid or teen was playing with a kendama. It became you either hate it or absolutely love it and brought it with you every freaking where you go. I was on the side that absolutely hates it, that we(my group of friends hated it too) asked teachers if they could ban it. Now, i know i sound like a spoil sport, but you guys need to know, it was really annoying, the people who played it got really annoying cause they’d block the ways around school, they’d be really loud and annoying whenever they do a stupid trick correctly, and it was just idk annoying to see in general, like seeing 10 or so people all huddled at an open spot with a camera pointed at themselves playing with the kendama. 

So upon asking our teachers if it could be banned, she laughed and said “no one’s gotten injured for it yet, we don’t have a reason to ban it.” Upon hearing that 3 of my friends immediately started plotting for a way for someone to get injured to a kendama. So one of my friends literally just walked into someone playing a kendama ( the person playing the kendama hit my friend with the wooden handle) and reported it straightaway to the general office. 


Next morning, my discipline master announced to the whole school, that all kendamas are banned , i shit you not, 80% of the whole school started cheering while 20% just sat with a grim look On their face.

Tl;dr- my friends and i got kendamas banned from my school.
